sentences.en: I think it would be, your pot fit my lid just right.
sentences.zh: 我觉得应该是，你的锅完美契合我的盖子。

sentences.en: I don't think either of them are real strong.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这两个都不太贴切。

sentences.en: If you find it, will you email us?
sentences.zh: 如果你找到了，能发邮件告诉我们吗？

sentences.en: I don't know where we are.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我们讲到哪了。

sentences.en: Michael and Pam are going to leave the Utica branch.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔和帕姆要离开尤蒂卡分部了。

sentences.en: Michael gives his lecture a B+.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔给他的讲座打了B+。

sentences.en: And then Pam says she's glad she came along and that seeing Karen gave her closure.
sentences.zh: 然后帕姆说很高兴她能一起来，见到凯伦让她释怀了。

sentences.en: Well, that's going to come back because as they're driving away, Michael tells Pam, you
sentences.zh: 好吧，这事儿还没完，因为当他们开车离开时，迈克尔对帕姆说，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I never got closure with Holly.
sentences.zh: 我还没跟霍莉好好告别呢。

sentences.en: She was the love of my life and I never got closure.
sentences.zh: 她是我一生挚爱，但我从没得到过一个了结。

sentences.en: So, Pam says, I think we should blow off this lecture in Rochester and go to Nashua instead.
sentences.zh: 于是帕姆说，我觉得我们应该翘掉罗切斯特的讲座，直接去纳舒厄。

sentences.en: Pam is like, yeah, screw them.
All of a sudden, Michael just got, what do the kids call it, a write or die?
sentences.zh: 突然之间，迈克尔就有了，现在的孩子怎么说来着，生死之交？

sentences.en: And then we have to be continued.
sentences.zh: 然后就出现了“未完待续”。

sentences.en: You think it's over, but there's a tag.
sentences.zh: 你以为结束了，但还有个彩蛋。

sentences.en: Jim is asking Creed for $3 for Kelly's party.
sentences.zh: 吉姆向克里德要3美元办凯利的派对。

sentences.en: And then he hands him a $3 bill.
sentences.zh: 然后他递给吉姆一张3美元的钞票。

sentences.en: I had to know whose face was on that $3 bill.
sentences.zh: 我当时就想知道那张3美元钞票上印的是谁的脸。

sentences.en: Because, you know, Phil Shea had to make that.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道，菲尔·谢伊得专门制作那张钞票。

sentences.en: You know who I thought it was?
It looked like Brad Pitt to me.
sentences.zh: 在我看来就像布拉德·皮特。

sentences.en: And I thought maybe it was a nod to BJ because he was doing the movie with Brad Pitt.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，这或许是在向BJ致敬，因为他当时正在和布拉德·皮特拍电影。

sentences.en: I remember we talked a lot about Brad Pitt when BJ was making that movie.
sentences.zh: 我记得BJ拍那部电影时，我们经常聊起布拉德·皮特。

sentences.en: We all thought we might become friends with him.
sentences.zh: 我们都以为自己能跟他成为朋友。

sentences.en: We were like, BJ, bring him to set.
sentences.zh: 我们当时说，BJ，带他来片场吧。

sentences.en: Maybe he'd like to come have lunch.
sentences.zh: 也许他愿意来吃顿午饭。
我们会表现得非常酷的，BJ。

sentences.en: He never brought him to work.
We went through that with John and George Clooney, too.
sentences.zh: 我们和约翰以及乔治·克鲁尼也经历过同样的事。

sentences.en: We were like, John, we're going to be so normal around George.
sentences.zh: 我们当时想，约翰，我们在乔治面前一定会表现得非常正常。

sentences.en: We're not going to bring up, you know, his place in Lake Como and that we want to go.
sentences.zh: 我们绝口不提，你知道的，他在科莫湖的住处，也不提我们想去那儿的事。

sentences.en: We won't say that we read about it in People Magazine.
sentences.zh: 我们不会说我们是在《人物》杂志上读到这些的。

sentences.en: We won't say any of those things.
Well, it turns out Randy Cordray told me who's on the $3 bill.
sentences.zh: 好吧，原来是兰迪·科德雷告诉我的，三美元钞票上印的是谁。

sentences.en: He said Phil made it, and that's who he put on it.
sentences.zh: 他说那是菲尔做的，他把那个人印在了上面。

sentences.en: You guys, that's Lecture Circuit Part 1.
sentences.zh: 各位，以上就是《巡回演讲》第一部分。

sentences.en: We'll be back next week with Lecture Circuit Part 2 and a lot of stories about licking cats.
sentences.zh: 下周我们将带来《巡回演讲》第二部分，还有许多关于舔猫的故事。
你刚才那句说得太有中西部味儿了。

sentences.en: And a lot of stories about licking cats.
sentences.zh: 还有许多关于舔猫的故事。

sentences.en: Sometimes your Missouri really comes out, and I live for it.
sentences.zh: 有时候你的密苏里口音真的会冒出来，我太爱听这个了。

sentences.en: Here, I'll give you some Missouri.
sentences.zh: 来，我给你来点密苏里味儿的。
